items: [Parsing] accepted grammar: one or more `<digits><unit>` parts, units `h` `m` `s`
[Parsing] units must appear in the order h, m, s and at most once each
[Parsing] empty input and a number without a unit are refused
[Parsing] spaces and any other character are refused
[Parsing] overflow (in a part or in the total) returns `None`, never panics or wraps
[Formatting] parts are written largest first: hours, minutes, seconds
